title: NeoMundi Evidence external receipt, version 1
description: A third party's receipt, NORMALISED AND NOT INTERPRETED. Values are verbatim; no correspondence with a NeoMundi field is assumed. An external receipt is a DECLARATION, never primary evidence, and carrying a self-computed digest does not change that. Un recu tiers, NORMALISE ET NON INTERPRETE. Les valeurs sont verbatim ; aucune correspondance avec un champ NeoMundi n'est supposee.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the received bytes, computed BY US. The only digest in this document we can vouch for.

received_at_declared.description: When WE received it. Declared by us, and not an attested date.

fields.description: Candidate fields, each with its source path in the document. A field whose path does not resolve is ABSENT, never null.

value.description: VERBATIM. Never converted, never normalised: a receipt writing 0,3863 keeps its comma.

digests.description: Every SHA-256-shaped string found, with where it appeared. What each commits to is NOT decided here.

signatures.description: ALWAYS EMPTY. The importer cannot recognise a verifiable signature, and declaring one would be pretending. A receipt must therefore never be described as cryptographically signed on the strength of this document.
